entities.summary: Maciej Rybiński was a Polish general, who was the last chief of State of November Uprising. He was a successful artillery commander of the Napoleonic Wars commanding in Prince Piatkowski's VIII Corps of the Grandee Arme in Napoleon's invasion of Russia.

entities.summary: Maciej Rybiński was a Polish general, who was the last chief of State of November Uprising. He was a successful artillery commander of the Napoleonic Wars commanding in Prince Piatkowski's VIII Corps of the Grandee Arme in Napoleon's invasion of Russia.
